formats.key: subscribe(address depositToken, uint256 depositAmount, uint256 minimumRwaReceived)
effects: The signer sends depositAmount of depositToken to the manager. The manager approves the OndoTokenRouter and deposits the tokens there (_processSubscription: safeTransferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), depositAmount)).

OUSG (0x1B19…ee92) is minted to the signer. The amount is (depositUSDValue - fee) / OUSG price, and the call reverts below minimumRwaReceived (subscribe: IRWALike(rwaToken).mint(_msgSender(), rwaAmountOut)).
A subscription fee taken from storage (ondoSubscriptionFees) lowers the OUSG minted. The signer's KYC/compliance status and rate limits are checked and updated.
formats.shown: Subscribe to OUSG: deposit {depositAmount} of the deposit token, receive at least {minimumRwaReceived} OUSG. The sentence adds a stray '+' after the OUSG amount.

findings.title: subscribe interpolatedIntent adds a trailing '+' that renders as 'OUSG+', which is the name of another Ondo token.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json subscribe interpolatedIntent: "Subscribe with {depositAmount} for at least {minimumRwaReceived}+". Case 0 screen: "…for at least 583.5187459421566 OUSG+". The blind reader was unsure "Whether the token received is OUSG or OUSG+".
findings.fix: Remove the '+': "Subscribe with {depositAmount} for at least {minimumRwaReceived}".

findings.title: subscribe: the fee, price and compliance checks come from storage contracts and are bounded only by the minimum OUSG shown.
findings.evidence: BaseRWAManager._processSubscription: fee = ondoSubscriptionFees.getAndUpdateFee(...); rwaAmountOut = ((depositUSDValue - fee) * RWA_NORMALIZER) / _getRwaPrice(); if (rwaAmountOut < minimumRwaReceived) revert.
findings.fix: None needed. 'Min OUSG Received' already bounds the outcome.

cases.notes: USDC out, 70001.493265, is shown exactly. 607.83 OUSG arrived, at or above the 583.52 minimum shown. The reader was unsure whether the token was OUSG or OUSG+ because of the stray '+'.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 rwaAmount, address receivingToken, uint256 minimumTokenReceived)
effects: The signer's OUSG (rwaAmount) is pulled to the manager with transferFrom, which spends the signer's OUSG allowance to the manager. The OUSG is then burned.

The signer receives receivingToken equal to (OUSG USD value - redemption fee) / token price. The call reverts below minimumTokenReceived (_processRedemption: safeTransfer(_msgSender(), receiveTokenAmount)).
The redemption fee and rate limits are read and updated in storage contracts. The signer's compliance/KYC status is checked.
formats.shown: Redeem OUSG: send {rwaAmount} OUSG, receive at least {minimumTokenReceived} of the receiving token. The sentence adds a stray '+' after the token amount.

findings.title: redeem interpolatedIntent adds a trailing '+' that renders as 'USDC+', which suggests a different token.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json redeem interpolatedIntent: "Redeem {rwaAmount} for at least {minimumTokenReceived}+". Case 1 screen: "…for at least 24002.303129 USDC+". The reader was unsure "Whether the 'USDC+' wording means a different token or just a typo".

findings.title: redeem spends the signer's OUSG allowance to the manager; this is the prerequisite of the stated redemption.
findings.evidence: OUSG_InstantManager.redeem: IRWALike(rwaToken).transferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), rwaAmount). In case 1 the OUSG approval from the signer to 0x9335…643a went to 0 (signer: grant).
findings.fix: None needed. Spending the allowance is part of the redemption.

findings.title: redeem: the fee and oracle price come from storage and are bounded only by the minimum received shown.
findings.evidence: BaseRWAManager._processRedemption: fee = ondoRedemptionFees.getAndUpdateFee(...); receiveTokenAmount = ((redemptionUSDValue - fee) * 10**decimals) / getAssetPrice; if (receiveTokenAmount < minimumTokenReceived) revert.

cases.notes: 217 OUSG out is shown exactly. 25002.399093 USDC arrived, at or above the 24002.303129 minimum shown. The OUSG allowance spent is not on screen (a prerequisite, info).
